alternate_titles: Catena aurea in quatuor Evangelia, in Lucam
work.author: Thomas Aquinas
work.description: Aquinas's continuous chain of patristic comment on the Gospel of Luke, compiled from Greek and Latin fathers and quoting each by name. It is a reception map and not an independent witness: an attribution in the chain must be checked back to the father's own work before it is cited as his. On the appointed Gospel of the Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost, at chapter 7 lectio 2, it assembles Cyril, Bede, Gregory of Nyssa, Chrysostom, Titus of Bostra, Ambrose and Theophylact. A locus is chapter, optionally with a lectio.
work.title: Catena aurea in Lucam
